mapper.sql: dcod.id, dcod.create_time, dcod.update_time, dcod.create_user_name, dcod.create_user_id, dcod.update_user_name, dcod.version, dcod.is_deleted, dcod.main_id, dcod.next_level_id, dcod.last_time, dcod.next_time, dcod.interval_time, dcod.override_time, dcod.max_retry_count, dcod.exec_timeout, dcod.disabled, dcod.extend_json
mapper.select: select dco.id as main_id, dcod.id, dcod.create_time, dcod.update_time, dcod.create_user_name, dcod.create_user_id, dcod.update_user_name, dcod.version, dcod.is_deleted, dcod.next_level_id, dcod.last_time, dcod.next_time, dcod.interval_time, dcod.override_time, dcod.max_retry_count, dcod.exec_timeout, dcod.disabled, dcod.extend_json from dmp_cfg_output dco left join dmp_cfg_output_detail dcod on dco.id = dcod.main_id and dcod.is_deleted = false and dcod.next_level_id = #{nextLevelId} where dco.is_deleted = false and dco.input_convert_id in ( select id from dmp_cfg_input_convert where is_deleted = false and main_id = #{inputId})
select approve_status, count(id) from dmp_cfg_output_detail where is_deleted = false group by approve_status
